text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both nearly flat over 24 hours, with BTC holding ground at $64k and ETH stable near $1,900, signaling cautious consolidation rather than directional conviction. Fear & Greed sits at 29 (Fear territory) and rose 4 points over a week, suggesting some stabilization in sentiment after deeper pessimism, though anxiety remains elevated. Bitcoin's 56.6% dominance and modest $49B daily volume indicate a market catching its breath—traders are neither capitulating nor aggressively re-entering, with attention split between majors and smaller alts like SOL underperforming.
